amendment_a.applies_to: every public DEV probe (all six probe kinds, all families)
amendment_a.name: bare_answer_system_instruction
amendment_a.precedence: the system message remains first when a teaching transcript is supplied
amendment_a.system_message: Return only the requested answer token or string. Do not add an explanation, label, or surrounding quotation marks.

descriptions.composition: Reverse the input string character by character. Then replace every lowercase vowel (a, e, i, o, u) with {param2}. Leave all other characters unchanged.
descriptions.conditional: If the input begins with a lowercase vowel (a, e, i, o, u), append {param1} to the input. Otherwise, prepend {param2} to the input.
descriptions.permutation: Reverse the input string character by character.
descriptions.substitution: Replace every lowercase vowel (a, e, i, o, u) with {param1}. Leave all other characters unchanged.

amendment_b.name: complete_oracle_rule_descriptions
amendment_b.unchanged: worked examples, operands, expected answers, splits, seeds and scoring

amendments.task_content_unchanged: every other field of every task and probe is byte-identical to the frozen meta_cortex/v3 public DEV view

max_new_tokens_change.comparability: v3 and v4-r20 scores are NOT comparable as a causal improvement; this is the same rule applied to the v2->v3 transition
max_new_tokens_change.justification: the G2 v3 artifact shows 10 of 15 oracle generations truncated mid-preamble at 32 new tokens; 128 is 4x the longest observed preamble and remains bounded
